# opnsense_ipsec_pool (Resource)

IPsec virtual address pools (VPN > IPsec > Pools), handed to road-warrior clients. Reference a pool by `id` in `opnsense_ipsec_connection.ip_pools`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Hand road-warrior clients an address and DNS servers.
resource "opnsense_ipsec_pool" "roadwarrior" {
  name      = "roadwarrior"
  addresses = "10.200.0.0/24"
  dns       = ["10.0.0.1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `addresses` (String) Address range to assign, as a network, e.g. `10.200.0.0/24`.
- `name` (String) Pool name.

### Optional

- `dns` (Set of String) DNS servers pushed to clients. Defaults to `[]`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the pool. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the pool.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_ipsec_pool.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
